decision: A failed manual operation uses operation state ExecutionError, session state FAILED, and Work Order state Paused.

persistence.migration: Additive migration after current 000023; never edit an applied migration.
persistence.session_constraint: Replace the named CHECK constraint additively so FAILED is accepted.
persistence.history: Add append-only wo_operation_execution_history for FAILED, ABORTED, and RETRY_REQUESTED actions with session, reason snapshot, actor, terminal, state changes, idempotency key, timestamps, and metadata.
persistence.reason_catalog: MES Master Data remains owner. Failure accepts only a Released reason code whose reason_type is ExecutionFailure; persist code, localized-name snapshot, and optional text in history.

command_policy.fail: Only matching active manual session; reason required; set session FAILED, operation ExecutionError, WO Paused, append history, write OperationFailed and WOStatusChanged atomically.
command_policy.abort: Only matching active manual session; set session ABORTED, operation Ready, keep WO InProgress, append history, write OperationAborted atomically.
command_policy.retry: Only Paused + ExecutionError with failure history; OPERATOR must match operator/terminal/site, PLANT_MANAGER needs site scope; set operation Ready and WO InProgress, append history, write RetryRequested and WOStatusChanged atomically.
command_policy.scrap: Scrap is part of successful confirmation. Nonzero scrap needs an approved scrap reason and quantity validation; it does not set ExecutionError or Paused.

successor_policy: Any direct or transitive successor remains non-executable until all predecessors are Finished. Failure blockers are returned by the read API; the UI does not infer them.
completion_policy: A Work Order cannot complete while any operation is not Finished, any session is IN_PROGRESS, or any required operation is ExecutionError.
print_policy: Manual fail/abort/retry endpoints reject PRINT_STATION. Existing print failure and print-retry flow remains separate.
